notes: Original paper title and replication project title verified against the assigned references. The supplied replication URL is an OSF file identifier, not a project node; its report was obtained via the supplied reference project 78fvn. The report explicitly identifies the original target as Experiment 1 overall mean d-prime SS-versus-random t-test. No Cohen's d for this comparison is printed in the original; es.value and metric remain null, with the printed t statistic retained. Group mean d-prime values are sensitivity outcomes, not a standardized between-group effect size. Replication effect sign follows the authors' random-minus-starting-small coding; no sign reversal or metric conversion performed.
